item.title: Supreme Court will decide whether Trump’s birthright citizenship order violates the Constitution
item.description: The Supreme Court agreed on Friday to take up the constitutionality of President Donald Trump’s order on birthright citizenship declaring that children born to parents who are in the United States illegally or temporarily are not American citizens.
